controls.name: Las Vegas Sands Corp.

vehicles.name: The Miriam Adelson Trust
vehicles.notes: Sold ~$2B of LVS stock in Dec 2023 to fund Mavericks purchase; exercised and sold 77,991 LVS option shares at ~$67.56 on 2025-12-16

vehicles.name: ESBT S Trust / ESBT Y-II Trust / QSST A-II Trust / QSST M-II Trust
vehicles.notes: Family trusts that on 2026-06-16 received 175.4M LVS shares distributed from the Sheldon G. Adelson 2007 Remainder Trust and 2007 Friends and Family Trust; on 2026-08-07 ESBT S-II transferred 43.9M shares to ESBT S Trust. Each holds ~6.8-7.2% of LVS.
